title: ASL Translation
summary: Real-time American Sign Language letter recognition using deep learning and MediaPipe hand tracking.
description:
ASL Translation is a real-time system that uses a deep learning model to interpret American Sign Language letters through the user's webcam.

## How it works

- MediaPipe Hand Landmarker detects 21 key points on the user's hand
- These landmarks are preprocessed and fed into a trained deep learning model
- The model predicts which ASL letter the user is signing

## Features

- Real-time hand tracking via webcam
- Deep learning model for letter classification
- MediaPipe integration for robust landmark detection
- Clean interface showing prediction results

## Future improvements

- Extend the model to recognize full words and phrases
- Improve prediction accuracy with more training data
- Add support for dynamic gestures (movement-based signs)
idea: The goal is to bridge communication gaps by enabling real-time translation of ASL letters using computer vision and deep learning.

title: Espoir En Soie
summary: Design and development of the official website for the Espoir En Soie association.
description:
Espoir En Soie is the official website for the non-profit association, designed to showcase their mission, team, and activities, while providing a platform for users to support their cause.

## Project Overview

- Created a multi-lingual, responsive interface tailored to the association's identity
- Implemented interactive elements like a custom image slider and dynamic cards
- Structured the navigation to clearly present the team, goals, and donation options

## Features

- Custom responsive design (HTML/CSS/JS)
- Multi-language support (French and English)
- Custom image slider and interactive UI elements
- Accessible and intuitive navigation

## Technical Details

- Built entirely with vanilla web technologies for fast loading times and simple maintenance
- Integrated FontAwesome for iconography
- Mobile-friendly design approach
idea: To provide the Espoir En Soie association with a strong and accessible digital presence to help them communicate their mission and gather support for their projects in Cambodia.
